title: Chapter 304: Support Of World Rules
content:
Chapter 304: Support Of World Rules

Gong Rui said to Wu Qing: "Lord Wu Qing, because there are a lot of special quotas for the status of a great clan, our clan has applied for one in advance!"

"Since you want to use this special quota, of course the sooner the better!"

"I am optimistic about the Zerg! I hope you can get the status of a great clan as soon as possible, and we will fight the enemy together!"

As Gong Rui said, he took out an ancient box and handed it to Wu Qing.

The box looked inconspicuous. Wu Qing took it and found that the box was not locked, and he did not feel any danger.

Gong Rui gestured: "Open it and take a look. This thing is a ball of rule energy, which is not rare!"

Wu Qing opened the box, and it was indeed a ball of strange energy. Wu Qing could sense the rule power in it.

Gong Rui continued: "As long as this group of rule energy is integrated with any lord's scepter of the Zerg's territory, the Zerg will have a chance to advance to a large clan!"

"I don't know the specific conditions. It will definitely be difficult. You need to explore it on your own!"

"I think that things obtained through one's own efforts must be better than things given by others!"

In fact, everyone understands the truth, but most people don't dare to try this kind of thing that is almost impossible to succeed.

Wu Qing closed the box, smiled, and said, "I think so too!"

"Haha, I wouldn't believe it if someone else said it, but when you said it, my confidence doubled!"

Gong Rui laughed, and then he continued, "I have another good news!"

"The human race was the first to stand up and clearly reject our appeal. They were afraid that there would be grudges between our two races, so they took the initiative to offer to support you with a batch of luck beads!"

"With the human race taking the lead, each major clan has expressed its support, which is considered compensation and support for you!"

"Everyone still recognizes your strength, but the timing is not right now, and they can't be blamed entirely!"

"My clan has collected those luck beads. Here is a detailed list. When you go back later, take these luck beads back!"

"There are quite a lot of luck beads in this batch. You should make good use of them!"

Gong Rui took out another list and handed it to Wu Qing. Wu Qing flipped through it. The list detailed the number of luck beads that each major clan in the local camp supported the Zerg.

This is the handiwork of all the big clans in the entire local camp. Although the amount given varies, the total amount is a very large number.

Wu Qing notified the Queen of Zerg and urgently sent a team of transport-type Zerg hosts from the first Zerg sub-base in the 66th city.

"These luck beads are very important for the development of the Zerg!"

"Express my gratitude to the human race and all the big clans for me!"

Wu Qing accepted this great gift.

Although most of the big clans did this because of the favor of the two super big clans, the goblin clan and the human race, it did help Wu Qing.

With enough resources, the Zerg has the capital to develop faster. Now the Zerg has to rely on its own strength to gain the status of a big clan. This batch of resources came very timely.

Wu Qing's goal is far from what people in this world can understand. He doesn't need to compete with the big clans in the local camp.

After the matter was done, Gong Rui took the technical information given by Wu Qing and became a little restless. Now Wu Qing's identity is different, and he can't just leave.

Seeing this, Wu Qing took the initiative to express that the war in the front was tight and he had to rush back immediately.

Gong Rui happily returned to the tribe with the technical data. Wu Qing and other Zerg transport teams arrived and handed over a large number of luck beads supported by various major tribes in the local camp to Gong Yi.

The dozens of transport-type Zerg hosts sent by the Queen of the Insects were almost full. Even Gong Yi sighed that he had never seen so many luck beads.

The Goblin tribe guarding these luck beads were all seven-star or above strong and a large number of powerful Goblin mechanical creations, and there were even stronger Goblin strongmen sitting in secret.

All the transport-type Zerg hosts sent by the Queen of the Insects were five-star transport-type Zerg hosts. Except for the extra loading space, the transport-type Zerg hosts were no weaker than the Zerg hosts and did not need protection at all.

Therefore, the Zerg transport team had no guards.

The transport-type Zerg hosts flew into the air and entered the invisible state. Few people could detect their existence.

Even if a strong person or a person with special abilities discovered them, the Queen of the Insects could descend on them at any time. With the current strength of the Queen of the Insects, she was not afraid of the powerful people of various tribes coming in person.

Gong Yi watched with some concern as Wu Qing entered a transport-type Zerg host, flew away with an astonishing number of luck beads, and gradually disappeared.

"Elder, do you want to provide protection in secret?"

Gong Yi couldn't help but ask.

The Goblin strongman who had been hiding in the dark replied calmly: "Don't worry, Wu Qing is not an ordinary person, there will be no problem!"

Since the elder said so, Gong Yi didn't think about it anymore.

...

Wu Qing's Zerg clone flew safely to the first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city with the special quota of the clan status and the luck beads.

The six-star Zerg host in the transport team did not find any goblin strongmen following, nor did they encounter strongmen of other races.

A safe journey and a smooth arrival.

The rule-level power contained in the ancient box represents the special quota of the clan status. It was transmitted to the hands of Wu Qing's body in the Zerg base through the pupa channel.

A large amount of luck beads were quickly converted into system gas resources by the Zerg. Once they become system resources, no one can take them away.

Wu Qing did not pay attention to the system gas resources, which had already exceeded the historical peak. He was using the special quota of the great clan.

Wu Qing took out the Lord's Scepter of the Great Xia Territory, opened the box, and brought the Lord's Scepter of the Great Xia Territory close to the magical rule energy.

When the Lord's Scepter touched the rule energy, the rule energy representing the special quota of the great clan naturally merged into the Lord's Scepter.

As the owner of the Lord's Scepter, Wu Qing immediately felt different. He seemed to have established some kind of connection with the rules of this world.

Wu Qing naturally understood that as long as enough foreign invading enemies were killed within the specified time, the world rules would give rewards and open part of the authority of the world rules to the race designated by Wu Qing to help the development of the race.

From this point, it can be seen that this world has been eroded by the foreign evil gods and their affiliated races. This abnormality of this world is a kind of self-rescue when facing foreign invasions.

This authority of the great clan status is a way for the world rules to cultivate thugs.

Wu Qing's original strength level was very high, especially he entered the super state many times, his strength has exceeded the scope of a world, in that state, it is very helpful for him to understand the rules of the world.

Wu Qing understands that the rules of this world, everything done, are based on instinct, it has no distinction between good and evil, just like the beast will instinctively fight back when threatened.

The lord system of this world, including the status and authority of the race, is a self-protection means of the world rules.

Wu Qing doesn't care how the rules of this world protect themselves, he only cares about whether the system can take this opportunity to give him some benefits when the rules of this world take the initiative to open up some world rules to him.

Using the special quota of the status of the clan is not without any effect. Wu Qing feels that the world's suppression of the strength of the main body has been greatly weakened. With a thought, his main body's strength immediately upgraded to six stars.

Wu Qing feels that it is not difficult to upgrade to a higher star, as long as he practices quietly.

The world not only relaxed its suppression of Wu Qing's strength, but all those who belonged to Wu Qing's forces also benefited from it. This was the prepayment for Wu Qing's forces to be thugs according to the world rules.

Wu Qing immediately discovered that the strength of Wu Cong and the human wanderers in the Daxia cavalry had instantly increased by one star through the Zerg host following other people.

Meng, Hu Wei, Hu Tu and the various lords of the alliance had made significant progress in strength.

The strength of the army of Daxia, the army of the alliance, the people who practiced the Nine Changes of the Silkworm and all the personnel directly under the Zerg forces had increased, and they all felt that it was much easier to improve their strength than before.

Even the Zerg army, many of the arms that had been accumulating in combat, had their strength increased by one star at this moment.

This was a reward given by the world rules to all creatures belonging to Wu Qing, helping to eliminate the alien creatures that invaded the world.

This state lasted for one year. If Wu Qing's forces did not kill enough alien creatures that invaded the world in one year and did not make enough contributions to the world, this state would disappear.

The generation of the status and authority of the great clan will fail simultaneously, which means that the world rules have given up on this useless person.

The main race that Wu Qing belongs to, the Zerg, will forever lose the favor of the world rules and can no longer obtain the status of a great clan.

It is difficult for the native races in this world to meet the requirements of the world rules in one year.

In the past, there should have been powerful races that could do it, so the standards of the world rules were set very high, and they wanted to select the truly powerful races and give them the greatest support.

But the times are different now, and the world rules have no wisdom and still act according to the rules, resulting in no race being able to pass this test and obtain the special status and authority of the great clan.

Now the Zerg, an alien race with system support, has mixed in and is expected to break this routine.

Wu Qing is full of confidence. The Zerg is most afraid of having no war to fight. Fighting wars and completing the assessment of the special status of the great clan is a two-pronged approach without increasing the burden on the Zerg.

Now the Zerg is fighting against three racial forces from the evil god camp: the aliens, the demons and the desert. It is not known whether the races from the underground world can be considered as foreign invading races. If they are considered, the Zerg is fighting four foreign wars of different scales at the same time.
